comics.title: Robot vacuum maps the office
comics.realStory: A sample office let its robot vacuum map the floor overnight. The map was perfect and the robot settled under the snack table.

panels.scene: Robo rolls across a big office floor at night with a tiny lamp on its head.
panels.caption: An office let its robot vacuum map the whole floor overnight.

panels.scene: Robo draws lines on a huge paper map while The Crowd sleeps at desks.
panels.caption: It measured every desk, chair and cable on the way.

panels.scene: Robo proudly holds up a giant finished map with a gold star.
panels.caption: By morning the map was perfect, down to the last stapler.

panels.scene: Robo naps under a table piled with snacks, crumbs everywhere.
panels.caption: Then it parked under the snack table and refused to leave.

comics.title: Coffee costs a dime more
comics.realStory: Sample cafes raised the price of a small coffee by ten cents this week. Regulars kept buying and asked for larger cups.

panels.scene: Coin stands at a cafe counter looking at a tiny paper cup.
panels.caption: Cafes nudged the price of a small coffee up by ten cents.

panels.scene: Coin counts a pile of small coins on the counter, sweating.
panels.caption: It is the second small bump this season.

panels.scene: The Crowd lines up anyway, each holding a mug.
panels.caption: Regulars kept ordering like nothing happened.

panels.scene: Coin hands over a bucket-sized cup with a big smile.
panels.caption: Their one request: bigger cups for the money.

comics.title: The choir gets kazoos
comics.realStory: A sample town choir added a kazoo section and twelve volunteers joined. Its spring concert will include a kazoo solo.

panels.scene: Newsie stands on a stage in front of three music stands.
panels.caption: A town choir announced a brand new kazoo section.

panels.scene: The Crowd holds tiny kazoos, cheeks puffed out.
panels.caption: Twelve volunteers signed up on the first night.

panels.scene: Boss Blob covers its ears while musical notes fly around.
panels.caption: The first rehearsal was loud and very enthusiastic.

panels.scene: The Crowd and Newsie bow while flowers land on the stage.
panels.caption: The spring concert will feature a kazoo solo.

comics.title: Everyone is a sourdough expert
comics.realStory: A wave of posts about naming sourdough starters is going around.

panels.scene: The Crowd stares at a jar of bubbling dough on a kitchen table.
panels.caption: This week the internet decided to bake bread again.

panels.scene: Newsie feeds the jar with a tiny spoon while The Crowd watches.
panels.caption: Everyone is naming their starter like a pet.

panels.scene: The jar overflows and dough creeps across the table.
panels.caption: The starters are growing faster than the jokes.

panels.scene: The Crowd sits around a huge loaf with a party hat on it.
panels.caption: Today the bread is the main character.

comics.title: Phones learn to nap
comics.realStory: A sample phone update adds a twenty minute quiet mode. Testers ended up using it every afternoon.

panels.scene: Robo holds a big phone that wears a sleeping mask.
panels.caption: A sample phone update adds a mode that silences everything for 20 minutes.

panels.scene: The Crowd taps their phones, which all show a moon.
panels.caption: Testers said the quiet felt strange at first.

panels.scene: Newsie snores on a pillow next to a phone.
panels.caption: Then they started using it every afternoon.

panels.scene: Robo tucks the phone into a tiny bed with a blanket.
panels.caption: The phone, apparently, also needed the rest.

comics.title: Piggy banks are back
comics.realStory: A sample toy store sold out of piggy banks as kids wanted to watch their savings grow. More are on order for the holidays.

panels.scene: Coin walks past a shop window full of piggy banks.
panels.caption: A sample toy store sold out of piggy banks in a week.

panels.scene: The Crowd carries piggy banks home under their arms.
panels.caption: Parents said kids wanted to see their savings grow.

panels.scene: Coin jumps into a piggy bank with a splash of coins.
panels.caption: Shops ordered more for the holidays.

panels.scene: Boss Blob shakes an empty piggy bank, looking puzzled.
panels.caption: Some grown-ups bought one for themselves too.

comics.title: Library lends out umbrellas
comics.realStory: A sample library started lending umbrellas with a library card. All forty umbrellas from the first rainy day came back.

panels.scene: Newsie stands under a library roof watching rain pour down.
panels.caption: A sample library now lends umbrellas like books.

panels.scene: The Crowd checks out umbrellas at a desk with a stamp.
panels.caption: You borrow one with your library card.

panels.scene: The Crowd walks home under three bright umbrellas.
panels.caption: Forty umbrellas went out on the first rainy day.

panels.scene: A tall stack of returned umbrellas drips by the door.
panels.caption: Every single one came back.

comics.title: Cats versus boxes, again
comics.realStory: A running joke compares expensive pet beds to the cardboard boxes pets actually prefer.

panels.scene: Robo holds out a fancy cushion while a box sits on the floor.
panels.caption: The internet is comparing fancy pet beds with empty boxes.

panels.scene: The Crowd points at the box and cheers.
panels.caption: The box is winning by a lot.

panels.scene: Coin tries to sell the cushion to nobody.
panels.caption: The expensive bed is getting no votes.

panels.scene: Robo sits inside the box, looking very pleased.
panels.caption: Even Robo picked the box.
